notes.title: "The Thief Girl" product version has been released!
notes.notes:
"Thief Girl" is a stealth action game where you collect treasure chests and aim for the goal without being found by monsters.

Product version contains 100 missions.
There are many stages in the second half where it is difficult to complete the S rank.
Let's try it!

In addition, demo version is also updated. 
You are welcome to try it too!

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: The freeze bug has been fixed.

notes.title: Demo version is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi all.

[b]Demo version is now available![/b]

Demo version contains 15 stages which are so easy.
Now we are designing more stages for product version.

Let's play The Thief Girl!
